result.instructions: Tools for Better Proposals, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which proposals were opened but not signed yet?"; "Show me all signed proposals and their totals."; "Create a draft proposal for Acme from our standard template.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Better Proposals data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run betterproposals_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run betterproposals_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run betterproposals_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. betterproposals_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: betterproposals_list_proposals
tools.title: List proposals
tools.description: List proposals in the account, optionally only one state: all, new, opened, sent, signed or paid. Each item carries the proposal id and its details. Vendor API: GET /proposal, /proposal/new, /proposal/opened, /proposal/sent, /proposal/signed, /proposal/paid.

status.description: Which proposals to list. Default all.

tools.name: betterproposals_get_proposal_count
tools.title: Count proposals
tools.description: Get the total number of proposals in the account. Vendor API: GET /proposal/count.

tools.name: betterproposals_get_proposal
tools.title: Get a proposal
tools.description: Get one proposal by id: its status, company, contacts, currency, totals, sections and links. Vendor API: GET /proposal/{id}.

proposal_id.description: The proposal id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: betterproposals_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the proposal templates in the account. Use a template id when creating a proposal. Vendor API: GET /template.

tools.name: betterproposals_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one template by id, with its sections and content. Vendor API: GET /template/{id}.

template_id.description: The template id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: betterproposals_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the client companies saved in the account. Use a company id when creating a proposal. Vendor API: GET /company.

tools.name: betterproposals_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Get one client company by id, with its contact details. Vendor API: GET /company/{id}.

company_id.description: The company id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: betterproposals_list_currencies
tools.title: List currencies
tools.description: List the currencies available for proposals. Vendor API: GET /currency.

tools.name: betterproposals_get_currency
tools.title: Get a currency
tools.description: Get one currency by id. Vendor API: GET /currency/{id}.

currency_id.description: The currency id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: betterproposals_list_document_types
tools.title: List document types
tools.description: List the document types (for example Proposal). Use a name or id when creating a proposal. Vendor API: GET /doctype.

tools.name: betterproposals_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: List the quotes in the account. Vendor API: GET /quote.

tools.name: betterproposals_get_quote
tools.title: Get a quote
tools.description: Get one quote by id, with its line items and totals. Vendor API: GET /quote/{id}.

quote_id.description: The quote id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: betterproposals_get_settings
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Get the account settings (also a cheap check that the token works). Vendor API: GET /settings.

tools.name: betterproposals_get_brand_settings
tools.title: Get brand settings
tools.description: Get the brand settings (brands, logos, colours) of the account. Vendor API: GET /settings/brand.

tools.name: betterproposals_list_merge_tags
tools.title: List merge tags
tools.description: List the custom merge tags of the account, for use in MergeTags when creating a proposal. Vendor API: GET /settings/merge_tag.

tools.name: betterproposals_list_library_items
tools.title: List content library items
tools.description: List the items of the account's Content Library (blocks, sections, pricing tables), newest first. Set prebuilt to list the vendor's prebuilt blocks and sections instead. Vendor API: GET /library.

prebuilt.description: true lists the prebuilt blocks and sections instead of the account's own items.

tools.name: betterproposals_get_library_item
tools.title: Get a content library item
tools.description: Get one Content Library item with its full content: a block's HTML, a section's blocks, or a pricing table's line items. Vendor API: GET /library/{type}/{id}.

item_id.description: The content library item id (from the matching list tool).

tools.name: betterproposals_create_proposal
tools.title: Create a proposal
tools.description: Create a new proposal from a template for a company. Returns the proposal's view, preview and editor links. The vendor API reference documents no email step for this call. Vendor API: POST /proposal/create.

DocumentType.description: Document type id or name. The vendor default is Proposal.

Contacts.description: Recipients to add to the draft.

MergeTags.description: Merge tag values, as the vendor expects them, for example [{'tag': 'some_tag', 'value': 'Some Value'}].

tools.name: betterproposals_edit_proposal
tools.title: Edit a proposal
tools.description: Change settings of an existing proposal. Only the fields you pass change. Recipients are not editable here. Vendor API: POST /proposal/edit.

MergeTags.description: Merge tag values, as the vendor expects them.

prompts.title: Find proposals opened but not signed yet
prompts.description: List the proposals in the opened state. Open one proposal to see its company, totals and links.

prompts.name: review_signed_proposals_and_the_proposal_count
prompts.title: Review signed proposals and the proposal count
prompts.description: List the signed proposals and read one of them for its totals. Count all proposals in the account.

prompts.name: check_templates_and_merge_tags_before_drafting
prompts.title: Check templates and merge tags before drafting
prompts.description: List the templates and open one to see its sections. List the custom merge tags you can use in a new proposal.

prompts.name: draft_a_proposal_from_a_template_for_a_client
prompts.title: Draft a proposal from a template for a client
prompts.description: Pick a company and a template. Create a proposal from them. The reply holds the view, preview and editor links.

prompts.name: change_the_settings_of_a_proposal
prompts.title: Change the settings of a proposal
prompts.description: Read the proposal first. Then change the settings you pass. Fields you leave out stay as they are. Recipients cannot be changed here.
